digest.component_or_area: ADR 0098 — operation-scoped configuration and provider composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must record the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries

Op-cert startup requires exactly one path or multiline value, validation before service work, process-owned file permissions, and context-local signer/principal/push policy without application-runtime SSM/boto3 coupling
ADR 0098 narrows ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition and explicitly preserves all unaffected decisions regarding Ed25519/DSSE protocol, trust roots, producer, and SSM-at-rest storage
The ADR must cite primary-source research for all external dependency behavior claims regarding Pydantic, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Git, Jira, and subprocess environment semantics

ADR 0098 status is Proposed with migration not yet implemented; documentation must avoid claiming active functionality and relate consistently to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 without superseding their unaffected decisions
No unresolved claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, or ADR conflicts exist after Draft Critique resolution; mechanical verification and maintainer approval are prerequisites to HOLD/MERGE
